persona: Assistant brand manager in personal care moving up to own a brand
resumeText:
Aditi Menon | Mumbai | aditi.menon@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Assistant Brand Manager, Konkan Consumer Products Ltd (hair oils and skin care), Mumbai (2022 - present)
- Wrote the annual brand plan for a coconut hair oil brand with the brand manager.
- Ran a U&A study and two concept tests with a research agency to find new usage occasions.
- Briefed the creative agency on a TV and digital campaign and approved storyboards.
- Planned BTL activations in 400 chemist and grocery outlets in Maharashtra.
- Launched a non-sticky hair oil variant in six states with R&D, packaging and sales teams.
- Tracked monthly market share and distribution from Nielsen retail audit data.
- Presented the launch plan to 150 sales managers at the annual sales conference.

Marketing Executive, Western Foods Ltd, Nagpur (2020 - 2022)
- Coordinated consumer sampling and in-store promotions for a biscuit brand.

EDUCATION
MBA Marketing, Narsee Monjee Institute of Management Studies, Mumbai, 2020
